tests.command: vendor/PATCHES.md coverage check: C01-C06 sections with file, item, what it opened, and why native API was unreachable

C01-VENDOR-GPUI-PRE.evidence: Cargo.toml declares [patch.crates-io] gpui-pre at vendor/gpui-pre; cargo tree -p gpui-pre resolves gpui-pre v0.3.6 to vendor/gpui-pre; cargo check --workspace exits 0.

C02-A11Y-ACTIVATION-GATE.evidence: vendor/gpui-pre/src/window.rs initializes a11y_active_flag to !accessibility_force_disabled; observer test observes_roles_labels_and_parentage passes with Some on a fresh window and no screen reader.

C03-NODE-BOUNDS-EXPOSURE.evidence: Window::a11y_node_bounds returns Bounds<Pixels> from A11y::node_bounds in logical pixels; observer publishes them as protocol Rect and the passing tests assert bounds.is_some().

C04-INPUT-HANDLER-EXPOSURE.evidence: Window::insert_input_text, Window::replace_input_text, and Window::a11y_focus_handle expose the live handler and focus resolution; input TypeText/ReplaceText and service Focus call them and cargo check -p gpui-mcp --tests exits 0.

C05-POINTER-POSITION-PRESERVATION.evidence: bounds_changed adopts the platform mouse position only when it differs from the last adopted position; test synthetic_hover_survives_bounds_changed passes across direct, resize, and DPI paths.

C06-TEXT-FALLBACK-STACK.evidence: vendor/gpui-pre/src/text_system.rs:374-378 rebuilds fallback candidates with fallback_with_requested_traits preserving weight, style, and features; unit test asserts fallback preserves requested traits and all 21 gpui-mcp lib tests pass.

C07-PATCHES-DOCUMENTATION.evidence: vendor/PATCHES.md records every C01-C06 change with file, item, what it opened, and why the native API was unreachable, including exact hunks and a re-apply recipe.

risks: Text insertion and replacement is verified through the compile-checked call path only; no fixture owns an active input handler for runtime exercise.
gpui-pre own test target cannot compile in-repo because vendored svg_renderer and example fonts use include_bytes paths absent from the archive.
